verdict.rationale: Cactus's core engine and models run entirely on the user's own hardware. The open-source GitHub engine installs via brew and starts with `cactus run` (gh-6), runs on macOS, Linux and Windows without a GPU (docs-11), and the vendor states 'no server, and no data leaving the device' (docs-24); community members report running it locally on a Framework Desktop and on Android phones (comm-19, comm-12, comm-13). The base model is downloadable and LoRA fine-tuning is free with the open-source package (docs-1, docs-2), but hosted GPUs, full-model training, the trained confidence head and 2-bit exports require the hosted platform (docs-3). Missing for 10: self-hostable full-model training, confidence-head training, 2-bit export and data-generation pipeline; explicit open-source license documentation.
